purpose: Fail-closed manufacture/install/material contract for the benchmark-visible circa-2000 neighborhood notice board. This is implementation-readiness evidence only; no Visual Fidelity point may be awarded without sealed native Unity render evidence.
periodIntent: Ordinary late-1990s to early-2000s Japanese neighborhood/municipal outdoor notice board: passive printed notices behind a clear weather cover, no electronic display or contemporary digital signage cue.
manufactureSequence: two painted tubular support posts are installed into the ground/foundation interface
a rigid rectangular frame is fixed between the posts
a recessed non-metallic backing panel is installed behind the frame face
printed paper notices are pinned/tacked to the backing surface
a clear UV-stabilized acrylic weather cover is retained by a perimeter EPDM gasket and front frame
three left-side hinge knuckles and a right-side latch retain the cover
a shallow top drip hood bears directly on the upper frame to shed runoff

paintedSteelFrameAndPosts.wetness: localized only after rain; dry benchmark default
paintedSteelFrameAndPosts.uvAging: slight chalking strongest on top/upward faces
paintedSteelFrameAndPosts.angularFresnelResponse: dielectric reflection; no metallic tint and no baked highlight

exposedHingeLatchSteel.angularFresnelResponse: metallic environment reflection from actual probes/sky

backingPanel.wetness: protected behind clear cover; no broad wet sheen
backingPanel.uvAging: mild desaturation from long-term indirect daylight

clearAcrylicCover.microstructure: very fine wiping haze only; macro reflections come from actual lighting/probes
clearAcrylicCover.uvAging: very slight warm/yellow cast only; must remain visibly transparent
clearAcrylicCover.angularFresnelResponse: stronger reflection at grazing angle from dielectric Fresnel; no painted reflection

epdmGasket.uvAging: minor surface chalking without metallic/glossy conversion

printedPaper.microstructure: paper fibre plus printed ink generated in material texture, not modeled as raised geometry
printedPaper.uvAging: different sheets fade/yellow at different rates

forbidden: raised geometry pretending to be printed text
single opaque dark rectangle pretending to be glazing

orientationExposureAging.front: faces local +Z toward the benchmark camera side
orientationExposureAging.sunRain: top hood/frame receive strongest direct UV/rain; cover receives runoff and wiping exposure; backing/papers are sheltered
causeBasedAging: UV chalking on upper painted frame
minor vertical runoff at clear cover edges
splash darkening restricted to post feet by the parent furniture contract

lodPolicy.LOD0: full case, clear cover, gasket, hinges, latch, five notices and ten pin heads
lodPolicy.LOD1: same silhouette/case/cover/gasket/hinges/latch and five notices; pin heads omitted
lodPolicy.LOD2: same silhouette/case/cover/gasket/hinges/latch and five notices; no small pins
lodPolicy.LOD3: same outer case/cover/gasket, hinges/latch and five notice color blocks to avoid content-class pop; micro-print resolves through texture mipmapping
lodPolicy.critical: front-cover silhouette, notice occupancy, hinge/latch side and material class must not visibly pop

requiredEvidence: native 3840x2160 hero or oblique frame where HD_NoticeBoard is visible
100% crop showing frame depth, acrylic/front-frame separation, backing recess, paper seating, hinges and latch
grazing-light crop showing dielectric acrylic Fresnel separately from metallic hinge/latch and rough paper/backing
temporal pass through all four notice-board LOD tiers without visible cover/content pop
